g.text: Ride-Sharing Schema: Relational Tables + a Non-Relational Hot Path
driver_locations is architecturally special -- in-memory, not a durable table
Indexes: trips(rider_id, created_at) for ride-history pagination;
trips(driver_id, created_at) for a driver's earnings view.
Sharding: driver_locations is sharded geographically (matches the geo-index's
own partitioning); trips is sharded by rider_id/trip_id instead, since ride history
